result:
Write a story of tragedy but with hope.

Person 1 and Person 2 had been married for 25 years. Every day they promised to love each other until death. And for a long time, they did just that. Life was happy and content. But one day, tragedy struck. 

Person 2 became seriously ill. After months of treatment, they finally succumbed to their illness. In a matter of weeks, Person 1 was left in the world to mourn the passing of their beloved. Though life had hit an all-time low, Person 1 made a decision to celebrate Person 2's life. 

Person 1 chose to honor their beloved in the only way they could. They said yes to their favorite hobby - taking a walk to the beach. It was calming and beautiful, just like their life together. Even after death, their love story kept playing in their minds. 

And so, Person 1 walked on the beach with the sand sticking to their feet, and the waves of the sunset all around them. They smiled and nodded to all the waves and answered each one with a little head tilt. It was a beautiful gesture that reminded them of the life they shared with their beloved. 

As the day ended, Person 1 watched one more sunset. They let the colors fill their mind and allowed the waves of the ocean to wash away their grief. They still hadn't found the strength to say goodbye, but it was comforting to be with their beloved one more time. 

Person 1 may no longer be here, but when summertime rolls around each year, they make it a point to take a walk to the beach with their beloved. They walk back and forth on the same coastline, feeling the calmness of the waves everyday. 

Even though the sun is gone, the waves still keep calling to them. It is the beauty of nature, and it is their perfect reminder of the time they spent together.
